reason: 该插件的主要面向用户用途是界面布局体验优化：在 DeepSeek Harness 的设置页增加显示参数入口，允许通过滑块调节输入框与内容展示区的宽度并即时生效。证据显示其核心功能是设置持久化与运行时 CSS/样式应用（包括自定义变量和页面区域对齐），属于界面布局类插件，不涉及数据处理、外部服务调用或协作型功能。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DSH Web 的界面设置插件，在“设置→显示”中提供滑块，实时调整消息内容区和输入框的宽度并保存设置。
summaries.en: This is a DSH web UI plugin that adds a Display settings page with sliders to adjust chat content and composer widths in real time and save preferences.

capabilities: Provides adjustable UI layout controls for chat content and composer widths
Persists user-selected display preferences to local DSH settings
Applies width changes in the web client at runtime via bound settings updates
Includes an optional compatibility patch script for older DSH versions

reasons.code: README describes a Display settings page with two sliders that adjust input and content area widths (30%–100%, default 100%), live updates, and reset actions.
README states the node side registers a `dsh-width` settings namespace and persists values in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` with defaults for the two percentage fields.
README explains the browser side subscribes to setting changes and updates CSS variables (`--dsh-chat-content-width`, `--dsh-composer-card-max-width`) to resize layout elements in real time.
package.json `dsh.client.platform` is set to `web` and includes UI settings/runtime dependencies, confirming the plugin runs in the web interface.
Repository includes `scripts/patch-apiproxy.mjs`, documented as an optional helper for legacy DSH versions to expose settings namespaces.
